description: .NET iOS bindings for MediaPipe Tasks Audio Library.

The storage-neutral core shared by Papuma.Kernel (PostgreSQL) and Papuma.Kernel.Local (SQLite) — diff engine, privacy policies, model and validation, feed contracts. It comes with the kernel packages; install Papuma.Kernel or Papuma.Kernel.Local, not this package on its own.

Domain model for the GM.FileStorage catalog: the StoredFile aggregate (key, name, content type, size, checksum, metadata) with soft delete and domain events for uploads, replacements and deletes. Part of the GM.FileStorage family.
EF Core persistence for GM.FileStorage — entity type configurations mapping the stored-file domain (files and their searchable metadata) to gm_file_storage tables. Part of the GM.FileStorage family.

Azure Blob Storage IArchiveStore for Whizbang: archived event streams leave the database as Brotli-compressed chunks, with a manifest in the service's Postgres database. Supports Azurite and live Azure Blob Storage.
